## Invitations

The outreach activity generated 1479 invitations. Attendance was 256, representing a rate of 17.3 per cent. The figures provide a summary of participation during the reporting period and indicate the number of invited people who attended. Records were reviewed to ensure that invitations and attendance were reported consistently.

Operational arrangements also considered access to local communities. Van days were kept where roads allowed, supporting delivery of outreach activity in areas that could be reached safely. This approach was maintained alongside the invitation and attendance process.

## Contact

Contact activity included SMS communication and reminder messages. A total of 1261 invitations went with an SMS, and 1261 people received a reminder message. These contacts supported awareness of the outreach opportunity and provided a further prompt before attendance.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
